title: A lost tune
author: Braja K Sorkar
text:
two different mindsets
Where are they heading for
even you don`t know
Today in your consciousness
the desire of the tree lives in
Yet you have returned to me
like a lost tune
when and how it rings,
only the wind that touches it can tell
stanzas: the desire of the tree lives in

only the wind that touches it can tell
